question: Should maintainers grant a proof override and canary-deploy this recovery change with explicit monitoring, or require pre-merge deployed/shadow evidence first?
rationale: The contributor cannot safely manufacture the natural failed-shard production event described in the proof plan, so only a maintainer can accept deploy-first verification for this automation-sensitive path.

options.title: Canary with proof override
options.body: Apply a proof override, deploy with focused queue and workflow monitoring, and require the first natural failed shard to confirm the documented invariants before broader reliance.

options.title: Hold for deployed proof
options.body: Keep the PR unmerged until a staging, shadow, or equivalent real workflow environment demonstrates the after-fix recovery behavior.

recommendation.title: Canary with proof override
recommendation.body: Apply a proof override, deploy with focused queue and workflow monitoring, and require the first natural failed shard to confirm the documented invariants before broader reliance.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice controls proof policy and rollout risk for the repository's live maintenance automation.
